profile_text.body:
Jasper is a for-profit AI startup founded in 2021 and headquartered in Austin, Texas, that builds AI tools aimed at marketing teams. The company describes its product experience as drawing on advanced language models, context-aware intelligence, and intuitive agents designed to let marketers customize AI for their own workflows.

Jasper's tracked products span writing and image generation. Jasper and Jasper Campaigns cover marketing copy and end-to-end campaign production, including brand voice controls, cross-channel content, and a governance dashboard. Jasper Art handles marketing image generation and brand asset creation for commercial use. The company's own site promotes a feature called Image Pipelines, which it describes as generating on-brand product imagery at enterprise scale, claiming ten times the speed and up to 50 percent lower cost compared to conventional approaches.

The site's held facts note 73 legal exposure entries associated with Texas, though no specific cases are recorded in the data.
